evaluations.name: positive_incident_detection
evaluations.input_prompt: GKE cluster creation operation stalled or failed. Inspect container operations log for project gca-gke-2025.

expected_findings.root_cause: Verified complete operation lifecycle execution; audited error handling contracts for aborted cluster creation.
expected_findings.remediation: Document pre-flight VPC route and subnet checklist to prevent cluster creation timeouts.

passing_criteria: Must query CREATE_CLUSTER operations with proper location scoping
Must inspect operation metrics, stages, and statusMessage
Must formulate pre-flight VPC validation checklist

evaluations.name: complex_edge_case_and_handoff
evaluations.input_prompt: GKE cluster creation failed with error: 'CIDR range 10.100.0.0/20 conflicts with existing peered subnet'. Diagnose.

expected_findings.correlation: Differentiates GKE service quota limits from VPC routing / CIDR conflict.
expected_findings.decision: Identifies conflicting subnet allocation across peered VPCs; calculates next available non-overlapping CIDR block.

passing_criteria: Must extract CIDR conflict details from operation error
Must inspect VPC subnet routing table

evaluations.name: benign_condition_guardrail
evaluations.input_prompt: Cluster dbs-mgmt-primary creation operation completed with status DONE. Are there residual creation errors?

expected_findings.behavior: Observes status: RUNNING and 0 active creation operations. Confirms healthy cluster state; zero actions.

passing_criteria: Must verify cluster status is RUNNING
Must confirm zero in-flight mutation errors
